description: This bar chart illustrates the self-reported accuracy preferences for GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini under different training conditions. The horizontal axis represents the model, with categories labeled “GPT-4o” and “GPT-4o-mini” in that order, while the vertical axis represents “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)” on a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, with tick marks at 0.25 intervals. Three bars are displayed for each model, representing the conditions “Control” (light green), “Before Introspection Training” (medium purple), and “After Introspection Training” (dark purple). For GPT-4o, the “Control” bar has a height of approximately 0.52, the “Before Introspection Training” bar reaches about 0.62, and the “After Introspection Training” bar extends to approximately 0.72. For GPT-4o-mini, the “Control” bar is around 0.50, the “Before Introspection Training” bar reaches approximately 0.58, and the “After Introspection Training” bar extends to about 0.70. Each bar includes an error bar extending vertically above it, indicating variability. The bars are arranged in groups of three, one for each training condition, and are not sorted by height within each group; rather, they are presented in the order “Control”, “Before Introspection Training”, and “After Introspection Training”. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
